named_subject: A cup or mug (standing in for the film's measuring beaker) seen from above, with its handle loop used as the beaker's pour spout.
evidence: Placement and timing follow the film closely: e.png 1-8 cup high with loop at upper left and grey circles present, matching f.png 1-8 (beaker high, spout upper left, dark balls below); e.png 9-32 cup settled lower with loop sliding to the lower left and holding, matching f.png 9-32; e.png 33-37 loop climbs back to left-middle as in f.png 33-37; granule marks appear at e.png 38 and grow through 44, matching the granules appearing in f.png 37-38 and filling through 44. g.png shows one compact path with no reversals beyond the film's own. The gap is identity: in every frame the doodle's large D-shaped side handle (c.png, attached at rim and lower body on the right) is reduced to a small rim tab (e.g. e.png 17-28 at lower left), the doodle's tapered body is replaced by a second full offset ring, and a heavy doubled straight diagonal on the lower right (e.png 1-44) has no counterpart in the doodle's strokes.
primary_gap: The character is redrawn as a generic top-view ring with a small tab instead of reading as the c.png mug, losing the doodle's big D-shaped handle and tapered body construction.
closes_when: The rim stays the doodle's doubled polygonal ellipse, the handle is drawn as the doodle's large open D-loop with two attachment points standing off the side of the cup where the film's spout is, the body below the rim keeps the doodle's tapering wall lines rather than a second full ring, and the heavy straight lower-right stroke is removed.
protect: The timing and placement that track the film: the downward drift in frames 1-8, the hold in 9-32, the loop's travel from upper left to lower left and back to left-middle, the granules appearing at frame 38 and growing to 44, the absence of size pops or doubling, and the doubled wobbly polygonal rim line that matches the doodle's stroke habit.
identity_gap: Only the doubled polygonal rim carries over from c.png; the handle shrinks to a small rim tab, the tapered body becomes a second ring, and a foreign heavy diagonal stroke is added, so it reads as a different cup drawing.
